title: TailorMind: Towards Preference-Aligned Multimodal Content Generation
comment: 18 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables. Code available at this https URL
summary: Personalized content systems depend on available UGC and struggle when suitable content is absent, delayed, or costly to create. Although multimodal generators can synthesize content on demand, how to translate behavioral traces into generation-ready preferences remains underexplored. We study personalized multimodal content generation: creating user-tailored multimodal content without existing item pools or waiting for matching UGC. We propose TailorMind, linking collaborative preference modeling with controllable multimodal generation. TailorMind enriches sparse user histories via hypergraph collaborative filtering and optimizes textual profiles with ranking-error feedback and textual gradient descent. Retrieval-augmented style control grounds outputs in authentic UGC patterns, while cross-modal cohesion reflection reduces semantic drift. We construct TailorBench, a benchmark from three mainstream platforms evaluated along five dimensions: coherence, novelty, aesthetic, hallucination, profiling. Experiments show that TailorMind achieves competitive or stronger coherence, improves novelty and aesthetic quality over representative generation baselines and ground-truth UGC, demonstrating advantages over retrieving available content or comparable UGC, while achieving up to 29% Recall gains in reranking. Our code is released at: .

AI.tldr: TailorMind通过协同偏好建模和可控多模态生成实现个性化内容生成，在连贯性、新颖性和美学上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 个性化内容系统依赖UGC，当合适内容缺失、延迟或成本高时面临挑战；多模态生成器可合成内容，但将行为轨迹转化为生成偏好的方法尚不成熟。
AI.method: 提出TailorMind，包括超图协同过滤丰富用户历史、排序错误反馈和文本梯度下降优化文本档案、检索增强风格控制以及跨模态一致性反思；并构建TailorBench基准。
AI.result: TailorMind在连贯性上具有竞争力，新颖性和美学质量优于代表性生成基线和真实UGC，在重排中Recall提升高达29%。
AI.conclusion: TailorMind有效整合协同偏好与可控生成，为个性化多模态内容生成提供了可行方案，优于检索现有内容或UGC。

fulltext_AI.summary: 本文研究了超越现有UGC目录的个性化多模态内容生成任务，提出了TailorMind框架。该框架通过超图协同过滤增强稀疏用户历史，利用文本梯度下降优化用户画像，并结合检索增强风格控制和跨模态一致性反射生成与用户偏好对齐的多模态内容。同时构建了包含三个主流平台数据的TailorBench基准和五维评估指标。实验结果表明，TailorMind在用户对齐、新颖性和生成质量上优于现有生成和检索基线。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 首次系统研究个性化多模态内容生成，旨在突破现有内容图谱的个性化和新颖性上限；2. 提出TailorMind框架，连接数据驱动的协作偏好建模与可控多模态生成，包括超图协同过滤、文本梯度画像优化、检索增强风格控制和跨模态一致性反射；3. 构建TailorBench基准，包含多个主流平台的真实交互和丰富多模态内容，并提供五维统一评估体系；4. 全面实验证明TailorMind在用户对齐、新颖性和多模态生成质量上取得显著优势。
fulltext_AI.method_details: TailorMind框架包含三个核心部分：1) 超图协同过滤：利用内容标签作为超边构建统一超图，对用户和标签节点进行图传播，从而从稀疏历史中挖掘协作信号，推荐候选物品以丰富偏好上下文；2) 用户画像与迭代优化：通过多模态特征提取和LLM生成初始画像，然后使用文本梯度下降迭代优化——基于排序损失、LLM推理生成更新方向，将用户实际交互作为反馈，直到画像能准确排序验证集物品；3) 个性化内容生成：检索与画像语义相似的UGC示例作为风格参考，并通过跨模态一致性反射（使用CLIPScore评估图文一致性、文本历史相关性）进行多轮修正，确保生成内容与画像对齐。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 当前社交平台仍以UGC驱动为主，创作者难以获取明确或结构化的粉丝偏好信号，这限制了AIGC系统直接辅助创作的能力。若平台能在隐私、同意和治理约束下向创作者披露部分聚合的高层偏好信号，将有助于降低创作成本和时间。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 传统个性化方法受限于现有内容目录，而TailorMind通过生成与用户偏好对齐的新内容，解决了依赖UGC时的延迟、成本和内容缺失问题。其数据驱动的画像优化和跨模态对齐机制为平台提供了即时的、高质量的、高新颖性的内容生成能力，能够覆盖长尾兴趣和新兴趋势，推动个性化内容生成从“选择”走向“创造”，具有重要的应用价值和研究意义。

title: Towards Root Memories: Benchmarking and Enhancing Implicit Logical Memory Retrieval for Personalized LLMs
summary: Memory systems are essential for personalized Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing retrieval methods in these systems primarily rely on semantic similarity, potentially missing logically critical memories with limited semantic overlap. Current benchmarks remain inadequate for evaluating this problem. To address this gap, we construct IMLogic, the first high-quality benchmark targeting implicit logical memory retrieval in long-dialogue scenarios. Motivated by this challenge, we introduce root memory, a structured, decision-preserving representation that distills reusable personalized logic from long-term user histories. We then propose RootMem, a plug-and-play framework that first distills raw histories into structured root memories and then uses an LLM-based router to activate logically relevant ones, complementing semantic retrieval with personalized decision logic. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RootMem significantly outperforms the strongest retrieval baselines and consistently boosts the accuracy of existing memory agents. Our benchmark and codes will be available at .

AI.tldr: 提出RootMem框架，通过结构化根记忆和基于LLM的路由器提升大语言模型记忆检索的逻辑相关性。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统主要依赖语义相似度检索，可能遗漏语义重叠少但逻辑关键的回忆；当前基准不足以评估该问题。
AI.method: 构建IMLogic基准；引入根记忆（root memory），一种结构化、保留决策的表示，从用户长期历史中提炼可复用的个性化逻辑；提出RootMem框架，先将原始历史提炼为结构化根记忆，再使用基于LLM的路由器激活逻辑相关的记忆，补充语义检索。
AI.result: RootMem显著优于最强的检索基线，并持续提升现有记忆代理的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 根记忆方法有效，将开源基准和代码。

fulltext_AI.summary: 论文针对现有记忆系统依赖语义相似性检索而忽视隐式逻辑记忆的问题，构建了首个面向隐式逻辑记忆检索的高质量基准IMLogic，并提出根记忆（root memory）表示及RootMem框架。RootMem通过从用户历史中提取结构化根记忆单元（包含执行规则和个性化证据），并在推理时利用LLM路由器激活相关单元，以补充语义检索。实验表明，RootMem在IMLogic上显著优于现有方法，并能稳定提升多种记忆代理的性能。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions:
1. 构建IMLogic，首个针对隐式逻辑记忆检索的高质量基准（长对话场景），包含20个长对话、超过15000条记忆和2216个QA对，明确建模语义相似性与逻辑相关性之间的冲突。
2. 提出根记忆（root memory）概念，一种结构化、保留决策逻辑的表示，并设计RootMem框架，通过离线构建和在线路由机制提取和利用根记忆。
3. 广泛实验验证RootMem的有效性：在IMLogic上相对最强基线提升27.23%，并作为即插即用模块使现有记忆代理准确率平均提升26.36%。
fulltext_AI.method_details:
IMLogic构建：基于HaluMem的长对话和记忆条目，利用LLM挖掘隐式逻辑记忆对（语义记忆m_s和逻辑记忆m_l），并通过Generator-Judger-Refiner流水线生成QA对，确保查询与m_s表面相似但正确回答依赖m_l。包含七种逻辑关联类别，支持记忆级和对话级评估。
RootMem框架：两阶段。1) 根记忆构建：周期性地将新记忆聚合为批次，由LLM提取器更新现有根记忆单元（每个单元包含执行规则ℛ_i和个性化逻辑证据ℰ_i），动态确定单元数量。2) 根记忆路由：推理时，LLM路由器根据执行规则ℛ_i判断是否激活单元，激活的单元与语义检索结果拼接形成逻辑引导上下文。
fulltext_AI.limitations:
1. IMLogic仅基于文本长对话，未覆盖多模态记忆（如图像、视频、位置、语音）。
2. 离线根记忆构建的效率有待优化，以适应实际部署。
3. 基准主要考虑推荐、建议和聊天三类查询，未探索更广泛的个性化交互场景、多语言设置或更多样化的用户上下文。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 本文揭示了现有语义检索在隐式逻辑记忆检索中的根本缺陷，并提供了首个专门基准IMLogic来系统评估该挑战。提出的根记忆和RootMem框架能够有效补偿语义检索缺失的逻辑信息，显著提升个性化LLM的响应准确性和可靠性，为下一代记忆系统设计提供了新方向，具有重要的学术和实践意义。

title: EvoEmbedding: Evolvable Representations for Long-Context Retrieval and Agentic Memory
summary: Existing embedding models are inherently static: they encode text segments in isolation, ignoring their surrounding context and temporal order. This paper introduces EvoEmbedding, a novel embedding model that generates evolvable representations for retrieval. It is tailored for long-context scenarios, where information is dynamic, sequential, and requires continuous state tracking. Our design is simple: EvoEmbedding maintains a continuously updated latent memory as it sequentially processes inputs, and uses it alongside the raw content to jointly generate evolvable embeddings. Consequently, for the same query, our model adapts its representation to retrieve distinct targets based on the evolving context, going beyond static semantic search. To equip the model with this capability, we construct EvoTrain-180K, a diverse dataset for the joint optimization of latent memory and retrieval. Furthermore, we introduce a memory queue to prevent representation collapse during recurrent encoding, alongside segment-batching techniques that tackle significant length variance and accelerate training by 3.8$\times$. Extensive experiments show that our model not only outperforms larger-scale specialists (e.g., Qwen3-Embedding-8B and KaLM-Embedding-Gemma3-12B) across a range of long-context retrieval benchmarks, but also generalizes well to downstream tasks (e.g., personalization) with contexts 10$\times$ longer than its training window. Notably, EvoEmbedding seamlessly integrates into agentic workflows to boost performance. For instance, a naive RAG pipeline equipped with our model surpasses dedicated agentic memory systems. Project Page: .

AI.tldr: EvoEmbedding是一种通过持续更新的潜在记忆和联合优化生成可演化表示的嵌入模型，在长上下文检索中超越更大规模的专业模型，并泛化到下游任务。
AI.motivation: 现有嵌入模型是静态的，忽略上下文和时序，无法处理动态、连续的长上下文信息。
AI.method: 维护持续更新的潜在记忆，与原始内容共同生成可演化嵌入；构建EvoTrain-180K数据集；引入内存队列防止表示崩溃；采用分段批处理加速训练。
AI.result: 在长上下文检索基准上优于Qwen3-Embedding-8B等更大规模模型，泛化到个人化等下游任务，上下文长度可超过训练窗口10倍，并提升RAG管线性能。
AI.conclusion: EvoEmbedding通过动态表示有效处理长上下文序列，提升检索和下游任务性能，可无缝集成到智能体工作流中。

fulltext_AI.summary: EvoEmbedding 是一种可演化的嵌入模型，通过维护持续更新的潜在记忆来生成上下文感知的表示，解决传统静态嵌入在长上下文场景中无法捕捉动态信息的问题。模型在多个长上下文检索和生成基准上取得了最先进性能，并可作为即插即用模块显著提升现有代理记忆系统。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 提出 EvoEmbedding 模型，通过潜在记忆队列生成上下文可演化的嵌入，实现动态检索；2. 设计记忆队列和动态分段批处理技术，防止表示崩溃并加速训练 3.8 倍；3. 构建 EvoTrain-180K 大规模数据集，支持模型训练；4. 实验证明 EvoEmbedding 在长上下文检索和生成任务上超越更大规模的静态模型，并有效增强代理记忆系统。
fulltext_AI.method_details: EvoEmbedding 基于 LLM 构建，采用双任务设计：记忆演化（通过交叉熵损失优化潜在记忆）和表示生成（通过长度加权的多正例对比损失优化嵌入）。模型使用固定容量的 FIFO 潜在记忆队列（C=512）存储最近 L 步生成的记忆令牌，避免递归编码崩溃。动态分段批处理将多个连续段并行处理，提高效率。训练数据 EvoTrain-180K 通过三阶段合成管道构建：原始上下文构建、动态 QA 生成、检索标注与验证。采用多 LoRA 设计解耦记忆与检索能力，保持基座模型参数冻结。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 1. 受限于计算资源和训练数据规模，模型在域外场景中性能可能下降；2. 当前不支持多模态检索，扩展至视觉或音频模态需要更大的队列容量和维度对齐。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: EvoEmbedding 从根本上改变了嵌入模型的静态特性，使检索能够感知上下文动态变化，为长上下文检索和代理记忆提供了更精准、高效的方案。其即插即用特性降低了部署成本，有望成为下一代检索系统的核心组件。

title: Factual Retrieval in LLMs Is a Redundant, Distributed and Non-Contiguous Process
summary: Large language models (LLMs) store and recall factual knowledge, yet the precise mechanism of how entity representations are transformed to enable specific attribute retrieval remains underexplored. In this work, we investigate this mechanism through the lens of an "attribute-computation path"-a sequence of computational steps over the entity representation required to elicit a target attribute. We then propose an iterative patching protocol to identify a minimal subset of layers necessary for this computation. Applying our method to LLaMA 3.1 8B and Qwen3 8B, we find that these paths are non-contiguous, often skipping layers, and that models possess multiple, functionally-equivalent paths for the same entity and fact, highlighting a high degree of redundancy in attribute computation. This implies that knowledge computation is highly distributed, potentially explaining the localization-editing mismatch and suggesting that knowledge storage and retrieval in LLMs is far from being well understood.

AI.tldr: 研究了LLMs中属性检索的计算路径，发现非连续且冗余的路径，表明知识计算高度分布。
AI.motivation: 探究实体表示如何转换为属性检索的精确机制，该过程尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出迭代补丁协议，识别属性计算路径所需的最小连续子层集合。
AI.result: 路径非连续，常跳跃层，且同一实体-事实存在多条功能等价的路径。
AI.conclusion: 知识计算高度分布，可能解释定位编辑不匹配，揭示知识存储与检索远未被充分理解。

fulltext_AI.summary: 本文通过属性计算路径（attribute-computation path）的视角研究LLM中的事实检索机制，提出一种迭代补丁协议来识别属性计算所需的最小子集层。在LLaMA 3.1 8B和Qwen3 8B上的实验发现，这些路径是非连续的、多层的，并且存在多个功能等价的路径，表明事实知识以高度冗余和分布的方式存储和检索。最小路径通常在早-中层结束，而替代路径更深更长。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 提出属性计算路径的概念，将实体丰富过程视为多步中间变换。2. 发现模型对同一事实拥有多个功能等价的路径，揭示知识表示的分布式和冗余性。3. 开发了一种新的激活补丁协议来识别属性计算所需的最小层子集。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 首先通过激活锁定（lock）操作确定属性充分层ℓ_attr，即最早使得锁定实体表示后模型仍能正确预测的层。然后使用隔离（isolate）补丁操作进行迭代贪婪搜索：从嵌入层开始，每次尽可能跳过最多的层，同时保持前缀有效（即仅通过当前路径层和锁定到ℓ_attr的表示能恢复正确预测）。隔离操作将路径外层的激活替换为反事实提示的激活。通过将上界从ℓ_attr放松至最后一层，类似过程可获取替代路径。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 冗余度的量化受限于贪婪搜索（非穷举）和仅考虑两种路径类型（主路径和以末层为上界的替代路径），因此发现的路径数量只是真实冗余度的下界。此外，替代路径是否在正常前向传播中被使用尚不明确，可能只是训练产生的退化痕迹。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 该研究挑战了事实存储于特定MLP层的简单观点，揭示了知识存储的分布性和冗余性，为定位-编辑失配现象提供了解释：编辑可能作用于必要变换阶段而非知识实际存储位置。这加深了对LLM内部知识检索机制的理解，并提供了精确的因果分析方法。

title: When Confidence Takes the Wrong Path: Diagnosing Retrieval-State Lock-In in RAG
summary: The trustworthiness of a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system depends on more than the answer it returns, yet many black-box uncertainty methods still read agreement among sampled answers as confidence. That inference fails when repeated samples condition on the same defective retrieval state. The state may be empty, with the model falling back on parametric memory, or populated by a coherent but wrong neighbourhood. In either case, the answers agree because the error is stable. The problem is recognised in deployed RAG, but it has lacked a name, a measurable signature, and a prevalence bound. We supply all three. We name the failure retrieval-state lock-in and diagnose it by separating the three objects a single confidence score conflates: the answer surface, the retrieved evidence, and the retrieval state itself. In an inspectable, ontology-guided knowledge-graph RAG (KG-RAG) system across six question-answering snapshots, we measure the agreement blind spot directly: at five samples per question, 42% of KG-RAG errors and 59% of dense-retrieval errors carry zero answer dispersion, so agreement has nothing to rank, while evidence- and retrieval-state checks still flag most of them. The decomposition supports an auditable decision rule: accepting an answer only when answer, evidence, and retrieval checks all agree that it is low-risk reaches 91.9% pooled precision against a 69.7% accept-all rate. The cost is coverage: it certifies only 7.7% of answers as low-risk. On the clinical calibration domain it reaches 100% precision under an automated judge; this is an in-domain automated-label upper bound, not a clinical safety claim, and still needs human validation. Confidence in RAG is object-specific: when answers agree, the useful question is which part of the pipeline to distrust.

AI.tldr: 提出检索状态锁定问题，通过分离答案面、检索证据和检索状态来诊断，在KG-RAG系统中测量了盲区，并提出了可审计的决策规则。
AI.motivation: 许多黑盒不确定性方法将采样答案的一致性视为置信度，但当重复采样条件化于相同的缺陷检索状态时，这种推断失败。该问题在部署的RAG中被认识到，但缺乏名称、可测量特征和普遍性界限。
AI.method: 在可检查的、本体引导的知识图谱RAG（KG-RAG）系统中，跨六个问答快照，通过分离答案面、检索证据和检索状态三个对象，直接测量一致性盲区。
AI.result: 在五个样本每问题下，42%的KG-RAG错误和59%的密集检索错误具有零答案分散，而证据和检索状态检查仍能标记大部分。提出的决策规则达到91.9%的合并精度，但只认证7.7%的答案为低风险。
AI.conclusion: RAG中的置信度是对象特定的：当答案一致时，有用的问题是管道的哪部分不可信。

fulltext_AI.summary: 本文识别了检索增强生成（RAG）系统中的一种故障模式——检索状态锁定（retrieval-state lock-in），即重复采样时检索状态固定不变，导致稳定但错误的答案。作者提出了一个三要素不确定性分解框架：答案状态、证据状态和检索状态，并在基于知识图谱的RAG（KG-RAG）系统中测量了沉默错误的普遍性。通过引入联合审计规则，在低覆盖率下实现了高精度。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions:
1. 命名并定义了“检索状态锁定”故障，提供了可测量的签名（沉默错误）和普遍性界限。
2. 提出了答案状态、证据状态和检索状态的三要素不确定性分解方法。
3. 引入了一种低成本答案状态分散度评分SD-UQ。
4. 展示了一个可操作的联合规则，在7.7%覆盖率下达到91.9%的精度。
5. 在多个数据集上提供了实证测量。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 使用OntoGraphRAG系统，一个本体引导的KG-RAG框架，具有实体优先路由、密集回退和图状态日志。不确定性度量包括：答案状态（DSE, SD-UQ）、证据状态（SEU）和检索状态（GPS）。在六个QA数据集（PubMedQA, RealMedQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue）上比较自适应KG-RAG和密集检索。沉默错误定义为错误答案且答案状态分散度为零。审计规则要求三个状态都判定低风险才接受答案。
fulltext_AI.limitations:
1. 分解方法基于图谱，但沉默错误在密集检索中更普遍。
2. 严格压力测试同时改变了多个管道组件，不是孤立变量。
3. GPS需要实体链接，对于是非题等无效。
4. 审计规则覆盖率低（7.7%）。
5. 临床领域的精度是自动标签上限，非临床安全声明，需人工验证。
6. 沉默错误率因混淆因素而成为上界。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 该工作解决了RAG系统中答案一致性可能误导信任的关键问题，提供了诊断和缓解稳定错误答案的系统方法。对于需要高可靠性的应用（如临床QA）至关重要，为可审计的弃权提供了实用工具。

title: CLI-Universe: Towards Verifiable Task Synthesis Engine for Terminal Agents
summary: While recent LLM-based terminal agents have demonstrated promising capabilities, the scarcity of high-quality, executable training data remains a critical bottleneck. Existing synthesis pipelines typically scale by retrofitting surface-level artifacts into tasks, frequently yielding ambiguous instructions, shallow execution paths, and brittle tests that provide weak learning signals. To overcome this, we introduce CLI-Universe, a principled synthesis engine that constructs terminal-agent tasks. CLI-Universe generates candidate tasks by sampling combinations across a multi-dimensional capability taxonomy (domain, skill type, capability, and engineering pillar), then grounds each candidate through evidence-guided deep research over real-world technical materials. To ensure rigorous supervision, validated blueprints are instantiated into Dockerized environments and subjected to a multi-stage executable verification pipeline featuring rubric-gated test construction, hint-conditional filtering, and strict fail-to-pass checking. Across the full pipeline, from candidate generation to verification, approximately two-thirds of candidates are discarded, retaining only those that are genuine, verifiable, and non-trivially challenging. To validate our framework, we instantiate a highly distilled dataset of 6,000 trajectories called CLI-Universe-6K. Remarkably, fine-tuning Qwen3-32B on CLI-Universe-6K achieves 33.4% on Terminal-Bench 2.0. This sets a new state-of-the-art for models trained on open-source data at or below 32B parameters, and outperforms several models an order of magnitude larger, demonstrating the profound data efficiency of structured, high-fidelity synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出CLI-Universe，一种生成高质量终端代理训练数据的合成引擎，通过多阶段验证生成6000条轨迹，微调小模型达到新SOTA，展示数据效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM终端代理缺乏高质量可执行训练数据，现有合成方法产生模糊指令、浅层执行路径和脆弱测试。
AI.method: 通过多维能力分类采样候选任务，基于真实技术材料进行证据引导深度研究，将验证蓝图实例化为Docker环境，经多阶段可执行验证流水线（评分门控测试、提示条件过滤、严格失败到通过检查），丢弃约三分之二候选。
AI.result: 实例化6000条轨迹数据集CLI-Universe-6K，微调Qwen3-32B在Terminal-Bench 2.0上达33.4%，在32B及以下参数开源数据训练模型中SOTA，优于大一个数量级模型。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、高保真合成带来深刻数据效率。

fulltext_AI.summary: CLI-Universe是一个用于终端代理（terminal agents）任务合成的引擎，它通过结构化能力规范、证据引导的深度研究和多阶段可执行验证，生成高质量、可验证的训练数据。在Qwen3-32B上微调仅6000条轨迹，即在Terminal-Bench 2.0上达到33.4%，超越了所有使用开源数据训练的≤32B模型，并优于多个规模大一个数量级的模型，展示了结构化、高保真合成所带来的数据效率。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 提出了一种数据合成流水线，通过结构化能力规范和证据引导的深度研究，生成基于真实技术材料的可执行终端代理任务。2. 设计了多阶段验证机制（评分门控测试构建、提示条件过滤、失败-通过检查），拒绝约三分之二的候选任务，确保训练信号的高保真度。3. 构建了包含6000条轨迹的高质量训练集CLI-Universe-6K，并实验证明在该数据集上微调的模型性能随模型规模单调提升，且可泛化到其他基准测试（如BFCL v4和VitaBench）。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 方法包含三个阶段：1）任务蓝图构建：通过多维能力分类（领域、技能类型、能力、工程支柱）采样候选任务，再由研究代理搜索真实技术材料（仓库、文档、问题讨论）进行证据引导细化，生成详细的蓝图。2）环境实现：根据蓝图获取或合成资产（如源码、配置），并组装为Docker容器，通过冒烟测试验证环境可用性。3）测试构建与可执行过滤：独立构建测试和参考解决方案，通过评分门控、提示条件过滤和失败-通过检查，仅保留可验证、有意义的任务。整个流水线保留约33.6%的候选任务。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 1) 流水线依赖LLM代理进行创意、环境构建、解决方案生成和测试构建，尽管有评分门控和可执行验证，数据质量天花板受限于底层模型能力。2) 虽然缩小了与专有系统的差距，但仍有明显性能缺口，未探索更大开源基础模型或强化学习能否进一步弥合。3) 当前数据集仅包含6000条轨迹，扩展到更大更多样的任务池可能带来进一步提升，但尚未进行。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 这项工作为解决终端代理训练数据稀缺和低质问题提供了新范式。通过结构化规范、证据引导和严格验证，CLI-Universe在极小数据量（6000条）下实现了显著性能提升，证明了数据质量远胜数量。其方法具有通用性，可迁移至其他代理任务合成，并为开放模型追赶专有系统提供了高效路径。此外，细粒度错误分析揭示了前沿模型和训练模型的失败模式，为后续改进指明了方向。

title: Cognitive Digital Twins: Ethical Risks and Governance for AI Systems That Model the Mind
summary: As AI systems become increasingly persistent and personalized, they make possible a class of technologies that we call cognitive digital twins (CDTs): dynamic computational representations of a specific person's cognition, updated from behavioral, contextual, or physiological data in order to model, predict, or simulate that person's cognition, or to act as that person's communicative or decision-making proxy. CDTs combine cognitive inference with longitudinal representation, simulation, and proxy action in ways that existing governance strategies for personal assistants, autonomous agents, recommender systems, and automated decision systems only partially address. This paper makes four contributions. First, we define CDTs and distinguish them from adjacent systems. Second, we introduce a 5A governance framework organized around authority, autonomy, access and control, accountability, and availability. Third, we identify CDT-specific risks, from misrepresentation and epistemic authority shifts to shadow twins, simulated participation, proxy action, and proxy-power asymmetries. Fourth, we analyze governance gaps and propose requirements for high-risk CDTs that strengthen consent, purpose limitation, validity, traceability, contestation, independent review, and model retirement. Existing frameworks primarily regulate data processing, automated decisions, or autonomous actions; CDTs also require governance at the level of cognitive representation itself, before any final decision or external action occurs. We argue that CDTs require governance not only because they can act for people, but because they can become infrastructures through which cognition is represented, simulated, classified, and operationalized.

AI.tldr: Defines cognitive digital twins (CDTs), proposes a 5A governance framework, identifies risks, and analyzes governance gaps.
AI.motivation: AI systems are increasingly persistent and personalized, enabling CDTs that existing governance strategies only partially address.
AI.method: Conceptual analysis yielding four contributions: definition of CDTs, 5A governance framework, risk identification, and governance gap analysis with requirements.
AI.result: Identified CDT-specific risks (e.g., misrepresentation, proxy-power asymmetries) and governance gaps; proposed requirements for high-risk CDTs.
AI.conclusion: CDTs require governance at the cognitive representation level because they can become infrastructures for representing, simulating, classifying, and operationalizing cognition.

fulltext_AI.summary: 该论文定义了认知数字孪生（CDT）的概念，将其与相邻系统区分开来，提出了一个5A治理框架（权威性、自主性、访问与控制、问责制、可用性），识别了CDT特有的风险（如误表征、认知权威转移、影子孪生、模拟参与、代理行动等），分析了现有治理框架的不足，并为高风险CDT提出了具体治理要求。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 明确定义了认知数字孪生（CDT）并区分了其与相关系统；2. 提出了5A治理框架，涵盖权威、自主、访问与控制、问责、可用性五轴；3. 识别了CDT特有的风险，包括误表征、认知权威转移、影子孪生、模拟参与、代理行动及代理权不对称；4. 分析了现有治理框架的差距，并为高风险CDT提出了加强同意、目的限制、有效性、可追溯性、争议、独立审查和模型退役的要求。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 论文采用概念分析和框架构建方法。首先通过场景和定义界定CDT，然后基于相关文献提出5A分析框架，接着系统性地识别风险，最后通过对比现有治理框架（如GDPR、EU AI Act、NIST AI RMF等）揭示治理差距，并提出具体治理要求。整个过程是定性的理论分析。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 论文主要基于欧盟法规框架，可能不适用于其他司法管辖区；提出的框架和风险是概念性的，缺乏实证验证；边界案例（如静态或代理模型）的治理触发条件需要进一步细化；论文未详细讨论实施成本和技术可行性。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 认知数字孪生代表了一类新兴的AI系统，它们不仅辅助人类，还模拟、代理甚至替代人类的认知参与，现有治理框架无法充分应对其独特风险。该论文首次系统性地定义了CDT并提出了专门的治理框架，为政策制定者、开发者和伦理学家提供了重要的概念工具和实践指南，有助于预防认知表征、模拟和代理带来的伦理与社会危害。

title: Lexical Consensus: Grounded Word Learning and Shared Meaning in Artificial Agents
comment: 41 pages, 12 figures, 9 tables. Code and experiment artifacts available at this https URL
summary: Artificial intelligence systems are commonly evaluated through task performance and behavioral imitation, but such evaluations leave open whether an artificial agent can acquire, stabilize, and use new lexical meanings from grounded experience. This paper introduces Lexical Consensus, an experimental framework for studying grounded word learning over a structured perceptual substrate. Using frozen DINOv2 visual embeddings, Carroll-style nonce words, and interpretable lexical learners plus linear baselines, we test whether agents can acquire artificial labels for visual concepts, generalize them bidirectionally, and stabilize them across controlled settings. The main result is a robust perceptual-coherence gradient: native categories are easiest to learn, coherent overextensions remain learnable, mid-range disjunctive concepts degrade, and far-disjunctive concepts approach chance. A pre-registered CIFAR-100 dissociation experiment confirms that this gradient is governed by perceptual distance rather than semantic relatedness: perceptual distance predicts acquisition accuracy (partial R^2 = 0.245, p < 1e-7), while semantic distance adds no significant explanatory power (partial R^2 = 0.002, p = 0.660). Bidirectional evaluation shows that naming and retrieval are distinct: exemplar-based mechanisms outperform centroid prototypes in label-to-image retrieval, exposing a memory-fidelity dimension separate from naming accuracy. Falsification controls, homogeneous candidate-pool evaluations, and null results on representational restructuring indicate that frozen perceptual geometry both enables lexical grounding and limits what can be acquired without representational adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Lexical Consensus框架，研究基于冻结视觉特征的词汇学习，发现感知一致性梯度主导学习难度，感知距离比语义距离更重要。
AI.motivation: 当前AI评估通常基于任务表现和行为模仿，但未考虑代理能否从具身经验中获取、稳定和使用新词汇意义。
AI.method: 使用冻结DINOv2视觉嵌入、Carroll式无意义词、可解释词汇学习器和线性基线，在结构化感知基底上进行实验，并包含预注册的CIFAR-100分离实验。
AI.result: 主要发现是感知一致性梯度：原生类别最易学，连续扩展可学，中距离分离概念退化，远距离分离概念接近随机；感知距离预测习得准确率（部分R²=0.245），语义距离无显著作用（部分R²=0.002）；命名和检索表现不同，示例机制优于中心原型。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的感知几何使词汇关联成为可能，但也限制了无需表征适应的学习范围。

fulltext_AI.summary: 本文提出Lexical Consensus框架，研究人工智能体在结构化感知基底上通过有限示例获取词汇意义的能力。使用冻结的DINOv2视觉嵌入和卡罗尔式非词，测试多种可解释词汇学习者的习得表现。主要发现是词汇习得遵循感知一致性梯度：原生类别最易，连贯过度扩展可学，远析取概念接近随机。预注册分离实验表明，这种梯度由感知距离而非语义相关性主导。双向评估显示命名和检索暴露不同能力，多智能体共识依赖共享感知几何而非表征重塑。伪造控制证实结果依赖于感知基底。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 提出可重复的接地词汇学习评估框架Lexical Consensus。2. 实现基于习得的AI评估测试的约束版本。3. 发现智能体根据感知一致性梯度获取标签。4. 通过分离实验确认感知距离主导习得，而非语义相关性。5. 显示双向接地中命名和检索暴露不同维度。6. 报告伪造控制、基线比较等验证结果。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 感知基底：使用冻结的DINOv2-small编码器提取归一化视觉嵌入（余弦归一化）。人工词汇：从Lewis Carroll词汇中选取非词标签（如slithy、mimsy），作为无语义输入。学习者：包括质心（单原型）、多质心、示例k-NN、逻辑回归、线性SVM和随机基线，均作用于冻结嵌入。概念类型：根据成员类间余弦距离分为原生（单类）、近析取（相干类对）、中析取（中等距离）、远析取（远距离类对）。双向接地：条件1（命名）对测试图像预测标签；条件2（检索）给定标签从候选池中选择最相似图像。候选池：包括标准N-way、随机大小池、硬负样本池、OOV池。多智能体共识：多个质心智能体接收不同种子集，通过投票（阈值0.7）达成共识，并追踪质心漂移和对齐。伪造控制：随机标签、随机嵌入、置换绑定、OOV拒绝等。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 框架不是完整的语言习得模型：感知基底冻结，智能体不从头学习感知；缺乏语法和句法学习；无真实交互环境；共识过程不重塑内部表征；实验限于小词汇量和静态词汇集。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 这项工作提供了一个可重复的基准来评估人工智能体接地词汇学习，将基于习得的评估从行为模仿转向可度量过程。它揭示了感知结构对词汇学习的约束，区分了命名和检索能力，并为未来研究语义习得和AI语言能力评估提供了定量框架。

title: moBERTo: A Modern Encoder for Portuguese via Continued Pretraining of ModernBERT
summary: Encoder-only transformer models remain essential for production NLP pipelines. We introduce moBERTo, a Portuguese adaptation of ModernBERT obtained through continued pretraining of the ModernBERT-base checkpoint on 60 billion tokens (5 epochs over a 12-billion-token corpus curated from FineWeb2 and filtered with educational and STEM classifiers). We preserve the original architecture, including rotary positional embeddings, alternating local-global attention, flash attention, and unpadding. We evaluate moBERTo across information retrieval (including long-context retrieval at up to 8,192 tokens), document classification, named entity recognition, and natural language understanding. Our best variant, which combines a Portuguese tokenizer with subword-matching embedding transfer and long-context post-training, achieves the highest average reranking nDCG@10 across three Portuguese retrieval benchmarks and the best results on PLUE-PT. Through ablation studies, we show that (i) continued pretraining is strongly preferable to training from scratch, particularly for preserving long-context capabilities; (ii) tokenizer adaptation improves token-level tasks but degrades long-context retrieval; (iii) a dedicated long-context post-training phase at 8,192 tokens further improves reranking and NER; and (iv) encoder-only architectures remain competitive with larger decoder-only alternatives for discriminative tasks. We publicly release the model weights at and training data at on Hugging Face.

AI.tldr: moBERTo is a Portuguese adaptation of ModernBERT obtained by continued pretraining on 60B tokens, achieving state-of-the-art results on Portuguese retrieval and NLU tasks while preserving long-context capabilities.
AI.motivation: Encoder-only transformer models remain essential for production NLP pipelines, but a high-quality Portuguese variant was lacking.
AI.method: We continued pretraining ModernBERT-base on 60B tokens (5 epochs over a 12B-token corpus from FineWeb2 filtered with educational and STEM classifiers), preserving the original architecture (RoPE, alternating local-global attention, flash attention, unpadding). The best variant combines a Portuguese tokenizer with subword-matching embedding transfer and long-context post-training at 8,192 tokens.
AI.result: Our best variant achieves the highest average reranking nDCG@10 across three Portuguese retrieval benchmarks and the best results on PLUE-PT.
AI.conclusion: Ablation studies show: (i) continued pretraining outperforms training from scratch, especially for long-context; (ii) tokenizer adaptation aids token-level tasks but harms long-context retrieval; (iii) long-context post-training improves reranking and NER; (iv) encoder-only architectures remain competitive with larger decoder-only models for discriminative tasks.

fulltext_AI.summary: moBERTo is a Portuguese adaptation of ModernBERT obtained via continued pretraining on 60B tokens of curated Portuguese text, preserving ModernBERT's architecture (RoPE, alternating local-global attention, flash attention, unpadding). The best variant, combining a Portuguese tokenizer with subword-matching embedding transfer and long-context post-training, achieves state-of-the-art results on Portuguese retrieval (avg. nDCG@10 0.5255), competitive performance on classification, NER, and NLU, while retaining efficiency. Ablations show continued pretraining strongly outperforms training from scratch, tokenizer adaptation aids token-level tasks but harms long-context retrieval unless mitigated by subword-matching, and long-context post-training yields further gains on reranking and NER.
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. Release of moBERTo, a Portuguese adaptation of ModernBERT, bringing modern encoder design to Portuguese NLP. 2. Comprehensive evaluation across multiple Portuguese benchmarks (retrieval, classification, NER, NLU). 3. Ablation studies on tokenizer adaptation, subword-matching embedding transfer, long-context post-training, and base architecture choice. 4. Public release of model weights and training dataset on Hugging Face.
fulltext_AI.method_details: Continued pretraining from ModernBERT-base on a curated 12B-token corpus (from FineWeb2, filtered with ClassiCC-PT educational and STEM classifiers) for 5 epochs (~60B tokens) at sequence length 1024, plus an optional long-context post-training phase of 10B tokens at 8192 context. Training uses the Composer framework with MLM objective (30% masking), StableAdamW optimizer (lr 5e-4), and ModernBERT hyperparameters. Multiple variants are trained: original tokenizer, Portuguese tokenizer with subword-matching (SWM) embedding transfer, and their long-context counterparts (-8k). An ablation variant (moBERTo-Tok) uses Portuguese tokenizer without embedding reconstruction, and moBERTo (scratch) is trained from random initialization.
fulltext_AI.limitations: Continued pretraining on Portuguese degrades English GLUE performance, especially for SWM variants due to the new tokenizer. Long-context post-training shows mixed effects on MLDR, not consistently improving over the base model. Tokenizer adaptation can degrade long-context retrieval, though SWM mitigates this. Classification benchmarks are near saturation, limiting differentiation. The model is only evaluated on Portuguese, so cross-lingual transfer is not explored.
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: moBERTo fills a gap for Portuguese NLP by providing a modern, efficient encoder that incorporates advances from ModernBERT, outperforming existing Portuguese encoders like BERTimbau across most tasks. It demonstrates the effectiveness of continued pretraining and adaptation strategies (tokenizer, long-context) for language-specific encoder development, and provides publicly available resources to support research and production applications.

title: A Multi-Agent Audit Framework for High-Stakes Reasoning: Evaluation and Interpretability in Clinical Mental Health Screening
summary: High-stakes reasoning tasks necessitate transparent and verifiable workflows, yet conventional single-model large language models (LLMs) often struggle with hallucination and low interpretability under zero-shot paradigms. To address this general AI challenge, we propose a Multi-Agent Audit Framework that simulates a collaborative, multi-step verification process. We empirically validate this architecture in the sensitive domain of clinical mental health screening using a modular LangChain workflow. Our framework decomposes the reasoning process into a Perception Agent, Knowledge Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Chain-of-Thought (CoT) clinical inference, and a critical Audit verification stage. We evaluated this framework on the DAIC-WOZ dataset using locally deployed open-source models. Experimental results demonstrate that our multi-agent pipeline significantly outperforms single-agent baselines, reducing the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) for PHQ-8 depression severity prediction from 5.35 to 5.02. By exposing cross-agent validation traces, the framework mitigates reasoning drift and provides highly interpretable diagnostic rationales, offering a generalizable paradigm for reliable AI-assisted decision support beyond isolated model scaling. We make data and code open access on GitHub for replicability.

AI.tldr: Multi-agent audit framework for transparent and interpretable clinical mental health screening.
AI.motivation: Conventional single-model LLMs suffer from hallucination and low interpretability in high-stakes reasoning tasks, motivating a transparent and verifiable workflow.
AI.method: A modular LangChain workflow with Perception Agent, Knowledge Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Chain-of-Thought clinical inference, and Audit verification stage, evaluated on the DAIC-WOZ dataset using open-source models.
AI.result: MAE for PHQ-8 depression severity prediction reduced from 5.35 to 5.02, outperforming single-agent baselines with interpretable diagnostic rationales.
AI.conclusion: The framework mitigates reasoning drift and provides highly interpretable rationales, offering a generalizable paradigm for reliable AI-assisted decision support beyond isolated model scaling.

fulltext_AI.summary: 提出一个多智能体审计框架，将临床心理健康筛查分解为感知、知识检索增强生成、思维链推理和审计验证四个阶段，在DAIC-WOZ数据集上使用开源大语言模型（LLaMA-3.1、Qwen2.5、DeepSeek-R1）将PHQ-8抑郁严重度预测的MAE从5.35降至5.02，并显著提升可解释性和推理稳定性。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: （1）提出用于临床心理健康诊断的多智能体框架；（2）将感知、检索增强医学知识、推理和审计验证集成到统一流水线；（3）提出包含五个可解释性和鲁棒性指标的过程导向评估协议；（4）在DAIC-WOZ基准上证明多智能体编排在预测准确性、可解释性和推理可靠性上优于传统单智能体方法。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 采用LangChain实现四智能体流水线：感知代理提取症状摘要；知识代理通过RAG检索DSM-5等标准；推理代理进行CoT推理并预测PHQ-8分数；审计代理验证推理一致性。使用Ollama本地部署模型（温度0.2），知识代理检索top-k=3，嵌入模型为nomic-embed-text。数据清洗包括去除时间戳、填充词、只保留患者话语。评估指标包括MAE和五个过程指标（知识基础一致性、推理稳定性、审计修正率、可解释性质量、幻觉率）。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 仅使用文本模态，未整合语音或面部行为特征；推理质量依赖检索参考文献；未与基于ClinicalBERT或RoBERTa的监督回归方法直接比较；工作流采用固定顺序结构，不支持动态代理交互。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 该框架通过结构化的多智能体协作显著提高了高风险临床推理的透明度和可靠性，减少了幻觉和推理漂移，为AI辅助决策支持提供了可泛化的范式，且因领域无关性可迁移至法律分析、财务审计等其他高风险推理任务。

title: The Score Granularity Gap in Black-Box LLM Classification: A Comparative Study of Confidence Constructions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as black-box classifiers in pipelines that automate confident decisions and route uncertain ones to human review. Such selective prediction needs a confidence score that an operator can threshold at a chosen risk level. Prior work asks whether LLM confidence is well calibrated or well ranked; we ask a complementary, deployment-oriented question that has been largely overlooked: at what resolution can the score be thresholded? We call the answer the score granularity gap. Through a controlled comparison of seven ways to build a confidence score, from a single verbalized number, to token probabilities, to querying the model many times and combining the answers, across 25 model-dataset pairs (9 LLMs, 3 benchmarks), we find that single-shot verbalized confidence, once correctly converted to a class probability, ranks cases surprisingly well, yet takes only a handful of distinct values. It therefore offers an operator only a few coarse thresholds, no matter how well it ranks. We show which constructions widen this gap, at what inference cost, and with what effect on ranking, notably that multi-query aggregation helps weak models but can degrade already-strong ones. We translate these trade-offs into concrete deployment guidance.

AI.tldr: 分析了LLM作为黑盒分类器时置信度分数的粒度差距，发现单次言语化置信度排名好但粒度差，多查询聚合对弱模型有帮助但可能降低强模型性能，并提供了部署指导。
AI.motivation: 先前工作关注置信度校准或排名，但忽略了分数可被阈值化的分辨率，即粒度差距，这在部署中至关重要。
AI.method: 通过对比七种置信度分数构建方法（从单一言语化数字到令牌概率再到多次查询组合），在25个模型-数据集对（9个LLM，3个基准）上进行评估。
AI.result: 单次言语化置信度正确转换为类概率后排名好但只取少量不同值，导致粒度差；多查询聚合对弱模型有帮助但可能降低强模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 将权衡转化为具体的部署指导，帮助选择适合实际应用的置信度分数构建方法。

title: IPO Finance Agent: Evaluation of LLM Financial Analysts beyond Finance Agent v2, with Automated Rubric Generation -- the Case of the SpaceX (SPCX) IPO
summary: Finance Agent v2 (by Vals AI) has emerged as the reference benchmark for evaluating both Anthropic Claude and OpenAI ChatGPT frontier language models on financial tasks. However, it narrowly deals with periodic reporting from publicly traded companies (SEC 10-K and 10-Q filings), and its agentic harness relies on naive, unenriched chunk retrieval. Neither the task design nor the retrieval approach addresses the distinct challenges of IPO due diligence. SEC S-1 filings combine historical financial statements, governance structures, pro forma and common-control accounting treatments, capital-formation narratives, and underwriting-sensitive risk disclosures within substantially longer documents than typical periodic filings. That is why we introduce IPO Finance Agent, which extends the Finance Agent v2 framework along two directions: task domain and retrieval architecture. During our experiments, the original Finance Agent v2 harness basically failed to deliver any output related to the SpaceX S-1 filing, due to document length. We therefore had to improve the agentic harness with contextual retrieval, a more realistic and industry-standard approach for long documents. We also built a dataset of 1,000 IPO-diligence questions, and publicly release 70 questions on the SpaceX (SPCX) S-1 filing to support reproducibility, while the remainder are held private to guard against benchmark contamination. In addition, we introduce an evaluator-optimizer pipeline to automatically generate evaluation rubrics for the benchmark: candidate facts are extracted from an ensemble of independently-generated model answers to each question, consolidated into draft criteria, then automatically audited for omissions, hallucinations, mistiered items, and redundancy, with LLM feedback driving iterative repair, targeted enrichment, and deduplication. Human experts only review final rubrics before deployment. Results show that the best-performing evaluated model, Alibaba Qwen 3.7 Max, reaches 79.4% accuracy at $0.30 per query, and the most cost-efficient model on the resulting Pareto frontier, Xiaomi MiMo-2.5 Pro, reaches slightly lower accuracy (76.8%) at $0.05 per query. Both exceed the current Finance Agent v2 leaderboard ceiling-Google Gemini 3.5 Flash at 57.9% for $2.51 per querywhile undercutting even FABv2's cheapest entry (MiniMax M3: 48.3% at $0.32) on cost-efficiency. Code and data are released on GitHub:

AI.tldr: 本文提出了IPO Finance Agent，扩展了Finance Agent v2框架，针对IPO尽职调查任务，改进了检索架构并构建了专用数据集，实验表明最佳模型达到79.4%准确率，成本效率显著优于现有基准。
AI.motivation: 现有Finance Agent v2仅适用于上市公司定期报告（10-K/10-Q），无法应对IPO尽职调查中S-1文件的长度和复杂性，且其检索方法未能处理长文档。因此需要针对IPO场景的扩展。
AI.method: 方法包括：采用上下文检索改进了代理框架；构建了1000个IPO尽职调查问题，公开了70个SpaceX S-1相关问题；提出了评估者-优化器流程自动生成评估标准。
AI.result: 最佳模型Alibaba Qwen 3.7 Max准确率79.4%，成本$0.30每查询；最经济模型Xiaomi MiMo-2.5 Pro准确率76.8%，成本$0.05；均超过Finance Agent v2的当前最优（Google Gemini 3.5 Flash: 57.9%, $2.51）。
AI.conclusion: 本文展示了针对IPO尽职调查的改进框架的有效性，显著提升了准确率和成本效率，并公开了代码和数据以促进后续研究。

title: Leveraging LaBSE with Progressive Curriculum Learning for Multicultural Polarization
summary: Detecting online polarization remains a critical challenge, particularly in multilingual and multicultural contexts where intergroup hostility is prevalent. The problem is particularly challenging due to the data scarcity for these tasks in the low-resource languages. Identifying such phenomena has become an active area of research and is addressed in SemEval-2026 Task 9: Multilingual, Multicultural Online Polarization Detection. To address this problem we propose an architecture that leverages LaBSE embeddings - an unconventional choice typically reserved for retrieval tasks, to obtain strong cross-lingual learning which enhances scores in low-resource language by a score up to 0.2 macro F1. Furthermore, we provide a comprehensive ablation study evaluating the performance of diverse encoder models in the Qwen model family within a retrieval-based prompting framework. Our code will be soon available at .

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用LaBSE嵌入和检索型提示框架对Qwen模型进行消融研究，以增强多语言在线极化检测，在低资源语言上获得最高0.2 macro F1提升。
AI.motivation: 多语言和多文化背景下的在线极化检测面临数据稀缺挑战，特别是低资源语言，SemEval-2026 Task 9 推动了该研究。
AI.method: 采用LaBSE嵌入实现跨语言学习，并在检索型提示框架内评估Qwen模型家族中的多种编码器。
AI.result: 在低资源语言上macro F1分数提升最高达0.2。
AI.conclusion: LaBSE嵌入在跨语言迁移中表现优异，检索型提示框架对低资源语言任务有效。

title: PeerCheck: Enhancing LLM-Generated Academic Reviews Towards Human-Level Quality
summary: As academic submissions grow, the traditional peer review process struggles to keep up, raising concerns about quality and fairness. A trend of using large language models (LLMs) for assistance has emerged. In this work, we take a critical step toward improving the quality of LLM-generated reviews. We propose the PeerCheck framework, which investigates LLM-human review differences (RQ1) and explores methods to improve LLM-generated review quality (RQ2). We first analyzed the human-written reviews with reviews generated by various LLMs and found that LLMs and humans focus on different terms, e.g., LLMs prioritize theory while humans emphasize methodology and experiments. We further adopt prompt engineering, such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT), and utilize retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to enhance the LLM-generated reviews towards human-level quality. We find CoT significantly improves the quality of LLM reviews, while we discover an unexpected "RAG paradox," i.e., experiments with RAG produce different results for various LLMs and, in some cases, even reduce review quality. Our comprehensive analysis of LLM-generated academic reviews illustrates both possibilities and limitations, contributing to a more effective, human-aligned review system. Our dataset is available on .

AI.tldr: 提出了PeerCheck框架，通过分析LLM与人类评审差异并采用CoT和RAG方法，旨在提升LLM生成学术评审的质量。
AI.motivation: 随着学术提交增加，传统同行评审面临挑战，LLM辅助评审成为趋势，因此需要提高LLM生成评审的质量。
AI.method: 通过RQ1分析LLM与人类评审在术语关注上的差异，RQ2采用提示工程（如CoT）和RAG方法改进LLM评审质量。
AI.result: 发现LLM与人类关注不同术语；CoT显著提升评审质量；RAG效果因模型而异，有时降低质量。
AI.conclusion: 研究展示了LLM生成评审的可能性和局限性，有助于建立更符合人类习惯的评审系统。

title: Storyline Trees: Hierarchical Representations for Long-Form Narratives
summary: Long-form narratives are challenging for long-context models because their structure is implicit: events, characters, and plotlines interact across hundreds of pages without the explicit cues that guide navigation in structured documents. We address this by constructing storyline trees, hierarchical representations that organize narratives from global themes and major plotlines to fine-grained events. We first segment chapters into contiguous narrative segments, or scenes, and use them as the basic units for tree construction. We then infer storyline trees through complementary top-down and bottom-up procedures that derive, refine, cluster, and summarize storylines at multiple levels of abstraction. We showcase the utility of this representation for question answering: storyline trees enable adaptive retrieval, allowing models to iteratively inspect high-level narrative structure and retrieve scene-level evidence on demand. Experiments on three long-context narrative QA benchmarks show that adaptive retrieval outperforms strong baselines, including post-trained long-context models and agentic chunk-based methods. Ablations confirm that scenes are more effective basic units than chapters or generic segmentation, and that gains persist under matched retrieval budgets

AI.tldr: 提出故事线树来组织长叙事，用于问答中的自适应检索，在基准测试中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 长叙述结构隐含，缺乏显式导航线索，使得长上下文模型难以处理。
AI.method: 将章节分割为场景作为基本单元，通过自顶向下和自底向上的过程推断故事线树，实现多层级叙事组织。
AI.result: 在三个长上下文叙事QA基准上，自适应检索优于强基线，消融实验证实场景作为基本单元的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 故事线树是一种有效的叙事结构表示，能够提升长叙事问答的性能。

title: CalVerT: Augmenting Agents with Calibrated Verifier Telemetry Improves Action and Learning in Knowledge-Intensive Tasks
summary: LLM agents in knowledge intensive question answering take retrieval and reasoning actions with incomplete knowledge about whether their current answer is uncertain, unsupported, or already complete. This produces two failure modes: committing to confident but unsupported answers, which hurts accuracy, and over-retrieving when the evidence in hand already suffices, resulting in wasted compute. To give agents a more complete picture of the state space they are operating in, we introduce calibrated verifier telemetry (CalVerT), which augments the agent's state with additional telemetry: a calibrated self-confidence score and a grounding verifier score. We show that CalVerT can improve agents in both training-free and training-based settings. On four QA benchmarks, we find that CalVerT raises F1 by triggering retrieval in cases where agents over-rely on parametric knowledge, while cutting redundant retrieval in cases where agents have sufficient context to answer. We show that CalVerT can augment existing QA frameworks without training. Moreover, CalVerT also improves trained systems: by simply augmenting an agent's state with telemetry, we observe improvements after reinforcement learning, as compared to an agent with identical training but no CalVerT telemetry.

title: Fixed RAG Compression Collapses Measured Reader Scaling
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) compression papers often evaluate a compressor on one to three readers and treat the compressed evidence layer as evaluation-neutral. We show this assumption is false: fixed compression can raise average accuracy while hiding reader upgrades and reversing model rankings. Across 20 readers and ten domain-method settings over four QA benchmarks and one summarization benchmark, compression gain decreases with reader baseline (nine of ten settings significant, p < 0.05). Generic summarization flips 31% of pairwise model rankings on LongMemEval-S, and a fixed HotpotQA compressor hides 80% of the raw upgrade from Qwen 7B to GPT-4.1-mini. Two opposing forces explain this paradox: compression rescues weak readers by removing noise they cannot filter, and harms strong readers by dropping details they would have used. The pattern appears across structured compilation, generic summarization, three trained compressor families, query-focused summarization, and an external audit of nine published compression papers. We release ragscale, a toolkit built on 177,000 row-level compression transitions, so any compression paper can audit reader scaling with three readers in one day.

AI.tldr: 固定压缩对不同能力的读者影响相反：弱读者受益，强读者受损，且压缩可隐藏模型排名变化，因此压缩评估不能假设是读者中性的。
AI.motivation: 当前RAG压缩论文常假设压缩对读者是评估中性的，但这一假设未被验证，可能导致评估偏差和错误结论。
AI.method: 在20个读者、10个领域-方法设置、4个QA基准和1个摘要基准上实验；对比固定压缩与原始文档的效果；分析压缩增益与读者基线能力的关系；开发ragscale工具基于177,000行压缩转换进行审计。
AI.result: 压缩增益随读者基线提升而下降（9/10显著）；通用摘要翻转31%模型排名；固定压缩隐藏80%从Qwen 7B到GPT-4.1-mini的升级收益；模式在多种压缩方法中一致。
AI.conclusion: 压缩评估必须考虑读者能力差异，不能假设压缩是评估中性的；ragscale工具可用于高效审计读者缩放效应。

title: Keyless Attention: Value-Space Routing and Value-Only Caching for Efficient Transformers
summary: We propose Keyless Attention, an attention mechanism that eliminates the key projection entirely, operating over queries and values only. This yields a Value-Only Cache that reduces KV cache memory and access overhead by exactly 50% over standard attention, while matching or exceeding standard attention's decode throughput. Beyond efficiency, we introduce Depth-$m$ Attention Factorization: standard attention computes a depth-2 factorization of the attention bilinear form, while Keyless Attention realizes a depth-$m$ instance of this family. At m=3, Keyless Attention matches the projection matrix count of standard attention via a value-space routing matrix that replaces the key projection and introduces a coupling between routing and retrieval. Experiments across five models and four architectures (GPT-2 280M, GPT-2 557M, Pythia 410M, Qwen2 1.5B, and Llama 3.2 1B) show that Keyless Attention matches or outperforms standard QKV attention on perplexity in 4 out of 5 models. On downstream zero-shot evaluation (GPT-2 557M), Keyless Attention outperforms on 4 out of 5 commonsense reasoning benchmarks, while achieving 50% KV cache reduction throughout.

AI.tldr: Keyless Attention eliminates key projection, using only queries and values, achieving 50% KV cache reduction while matching or improving performance.
AI.motivation: Reduce KV cache memory and access overhead in attention mechanisms.
AI.method: Proposes Keyless Attention with Value-Only Cache and Depth-m Attention Factorization, where the key projection is replaced by a value-space routing matrix.
AI.result: Matches or outperforms standard attention on perplexity in 4 out of 5 models and on 4 out of 5 commonsense reasoning benchmarks, with 50% KV cache reduction.
AI.conclusion: Keyless Attention offers an efficient alternative to standard QKV attention, reducing memory overhead without sacrificing performance.

title: Pre-Generation Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models via Soft-Target Attention Probing
summary: Detecting hallucination risk before generation enables abstention, retrieval augmentation, and routing decisions without incurring the cost of decoding. While prior work has shown that such risk can be estimated from a model's internal representations, existing approaches treat this as binary classification over a single decoded output. We instead formulate it as a risk-estimation problem. Under this formulation, we introduce soft-target supervision based on the empirical answer error rate over stochastically sampled outputs - an estimator we prove to be the unique unbiased minimum-variance estimator of the model's per-prompt error probability under its sampling distribution. We further adapt attention probing to the pre-generation setting, enabling the detector to selectively aggregate hallucination-relevant prompt representations. Across three question-answering benchmarks and five models, attention probing outperforms linear probing on short-answer tasks. Replacing binary labels with soft-target supervision further and consistently improves detection quality.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在生成前检测幻觉风险的风险估计方法，利用软目标监督和注意力探测，在多个基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉风险检测方法依赖单一解码输出进行二元分类，无法充分利用模型表示且成本较高。
AI.method: 将幻觉风险估计视为风险估计问题，引入基于随机采样输出经验答案错误率的软目标监督作为无偏最小方差估计量，并采用注意力探测在预生成阶段聚合幻觉相关提示表示。
AI.result: 在三个问答基准和五个模型上，注意力探测在短答案任务上优于线性探测，软目标监督进一步持续改进检测质量。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能有效在生成前评估幻觉风险，支持更可靠的弃权、检索增强等决策。

title: Beyond Value Benchmarks: Measuring Value-Structure Alignment in Large Language Models via Symmetric Q-Sorts
comment: 32 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables; accepted to ACL 2026 Main Conference
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in contexts requiring complex moral reasoning and value trade-offs. However, existing evaluations typically rely on item-level behavioral metrics, which fail to capture how models structurally prioritize competing values as a cohesive system. To address this, we propose a symmetric human-LLM evaluation framework, grounded in Q methodology, to measure value-structure alignment. Under our protocol, humans and models sort an identical 140-item moral statement set into a shared nine-column forced distribution; for LLMs, we elicit strict rankings and deterministically map them to Q-sort buckets. Using a human reference sample ($N=35$), we establish a stable three-factor reference geometry specific to this instrument and sample. We evaluate 12 LLMs across four model families via 240 replicated Q-sorts at two temperature settings, quantifying structural alignment via Procrustes similarity ($\phi$) and RSA-based Spearman correlation ($\rho$). Our results reveal significant cross-family heterogeneity, model-specific sensitivity to generation stochasticity and localized misalignment, which demonstrate that favorable global scores can obscure underlying regional distortions. While rank- and bucket-based analyses remain highly consistent, prompt phrasing introduces notable variance. Ultimately, assessing value-structure alignment provides a crucial structural complement to traditional itemwise moral benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于Q方法的对称人类-LLM评估框架来测量价值结构对齐，发现模型间存在显著异质性且全局分数可能掩盖局部不对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有评估主要依赖项目级行为指标，无法捕捉模型如何结构化地优先竞争价值。
AI.method: 使用Q方法，人类和LLM对140项道德陈述进行强制分布排序，基于35人参考样本建立三因素结构，评估12个LLM的240次复制Q分类，通过Procrustes相似性和RSA相关性量化对齐。
AI.result: 发现跨模型家族异质性、对随机性的模型特定敏感性及局部不对齐，提示措辞引入显著差异，全局分数可能掩盖局部扭曲。
AI.conclusion: 评估价值结构对齐是对传统逐项道德基准的关键结构性补充。

title: OpenBioRQ: Unsolved Biomedical Research Questions for Agents
summary: A working citation looks like proof -- but the fact that a link resolves does not mean the cited paper supports the claim. I find that current agentic models rarely fabricate citations (over $99\%$ resolve), yet roughly $15.9\%$ link to the wrong paper. Existing benchmarks miss this failure mode: when a question has a fixed answer key, a model can reproduce the expected source from that key rather than independently verifying that the source supports the claim. I introduce \textbf{\openbiorq{}}, a retrieval-grounded agentic benchmark of $12{,}553$ unsolved biomedical research questions across $12$ domains that treats open questions as a faithfulness-and-abstention probe. To my knowledge, this is the first biomedical benchmark to combine an agentic setting -- where the model must issue multiple tool calls -- with unsolved questions that have no answer key. Openness is verified against real follow-up evidence rather than a model's parametric knowledge. Difficulty is empirical: I anchor it on questions that three open-weight reference models fail to answer, rather than on subjective hardness labels. On this hardest subset, held-out models from the same lineage as the difficulty anchors solve only ~17%, while three independent frontier agents (Gemini-3-Pro, Opus-4.7, GPT-5.5) span a wide 29-60% range. The benchmark is thus hard, non-saturating (the best agent still leaves ~33-40\% unsolved), and discriminating across capability tiers. Beyond difficulty, I observe agentic collapse on the hardest questions, where agents stop using their tools. For the most collapse-prone model, blocking tool access entirely barely changes its score -- so tools stop paying off exactly where they are needed most. A frozen per-question checklist raises inter-judge agreement from Spearman 0.35 to 0.82.

AI.tldr: 介绍OpenBioRQ，一个检索增强的代理基准测试，包含12,553个未解决的生物医学研究问题，用于评估忠实性和放弃回答能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试忽略了模型可能引用错误论文的问题，当问题有固定答案时，模型可直接复现答案而不验证来源。
AI.method: 构建12,553个未解决的生物医学问题（12个领域），无答案键；难度通过三个开源模型无法回答来锚定；评估工具调用和引用准确性。
AI.result: 当前模型很少捏造引用（>99%可解析），但约15.9%链接到错误论文；最难子集上同类模型解决~17%，前沿模型29-60%；观察到工具使用崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 基准测试困难且非饱和，最佳模型仍留下33-40%未解决；工具在需要时失效；冻结的检查表提高评分者间一致性。

title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Hausa and Fongbe Machine Translation: Benchmarks, Failures, and Metric Reliability
summary: We investigate the translation quality of current large language models (LLMs) for English-to-Hausa and English-to-Fongbe - two typologically distinct West African languages from the Afroasiatic and Niger-Congo families respectively - and evaluate whether standard automatic metrics reliably reflect human judgment for these low-resource languages. We evaluate four models (GPT-4o Mini, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Qwen2.5-7B) at progressive scales (500 to 10,000 sentences) using automatic metrics (BLEU, chrF++, TER, COMET, BERTScore) validated against native-speaker judgment. Our results reveal three key findings. First, translation quality varies substantially by language: Hausa achieves acceptable quality (human scores 4.0-4.5/5) while Fongbe achieves poor quality (1.0-2.2/5), with a consistent 3x BLEU gap across all systems. Second, model rankings differ by language - Gemini leads for Fongbe while GPT-4o leads for Hausa by human evaluation - indicating that performance on one low-resource African language does not predict performance on another. Third, metric-human correlation varies dramatically: perfect rank correlation for Fongbe (rho=1.0) but weak correlation for Hausa (rho=0.5), where human evaluators preferred GPT-4o despite all automatic metrics ranking Claude first. We further show that neural metrics like BERTScore exhibit embedding collapse (within-language similarity >0.99) for both languages, limiting their ability to differentiate translation quality. Based on these findings, we recommend multi-metric evaluation for low-resource African languages, with particular caution when interpreting neural metrics. We establish that minimum sample sizes of n=2,500 sentences are required for stable system rankings, as smaller samples produced artifact findings that reversed at scale.
